newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt in alliance for imaging agent.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt in alliance for imaging agent.

text.p: Mallinckrodt Group Inc said it entered into a strategic alliance with METASYN Inc to develop and market a magnetic resonance imaging agent, MS-325, and other MRI vascular agents.
Mallinckrodt and METASYN have agreed to contribute assets, share in costs and any resulting profits from sales of MS-325 and other agents the two may collaborate on in the future.
The alliance comes as METASYN initiates U.S. Phase I clinical trials of MS-325, a noninvasive angiography imaging agent designed for imaging the cardiovascular system.
The companies will share in the costs associated with development, conducting clinical trials and efforts to achieve regulatory approval of MS-325 and other MRI vascular agents.
Pending development and regulatory approvals, Mallinckrodt said it will be responsible for future marketing and sales efforts of MS-325 in all parts of the world except Japan.
The agreement includes a front-end, $6 million license fee paid by Mallinckrodt to METASYN, the company said.
Mallinckrodt is a healthcare and chemicals company. METASYN is a privately-held development-stage medical diagnostics firm based in Cambridge, Mass.
